text: The navigation unit shall generate the altitude report every 100 milliseconds.
The altitude report shall be consumed by the display formatter before rendering.
The cabin pressure value shall be generated by the environmental sensor at 10 Hz.
The alarm module shall read the cabin pressure value to evaluate threshold breaches.
The thrust vector command shall be computed by the guidance processor each control cycle.
The actuator driver shall receive the thrust vector command over the internal bus.
The fault log entry shall be written by the diagnostics service on every anomaly.
The maintenance console shall retrieve the fault log entry for operator review.
The encryption key material shall be produced by the key management unit at startup.
The secure link handler shall load the encryption key material prior to session setup.
The sensor fusion module shall output altitude data and heading data at 20 Hz.
The autopilot shall use the altitude data to maintain the commanded flight level.
The heading indicator shall consume the heading data for cockpit display.
The telemetry encoder shall transmit the battery voltage, the bus current, and the cell temperature once per second.
The power monitor shall read the battery voltage to detect undervoltage conditions.
The load balancer shall process the bus current for distribution decisions.
The thermal guard shall monitor the cell temperature against the safety limit.
The recorder shall store the flight path history and the event timeline in non-volatile memory.
The replay tool shall retrieve the flight path history for post-flight analysis.
The audit service shall fetch the event timeline to reconstruct the incident sequence.
The probe shall measure the baseplate temperature reading at 5 Hz.
The controller shall use the baseplate temp value to drive the cooling loop.
The GPS module shall compute the aircraft position fix once per second.
The route planner shall require the aircraft location estimate to update the flight plan.
The radio shall emit the downlink telemetry frame on the S-band channel.
The ground segment shall accept the downlink telemetry packet for archival.
The engine controller shall report the rotor speed measurement to the health monitor.
The vibration analyzer shall obtain the rotor rpm reading for spectral analysis.
The flight computer shall calculate the fuel quantity estimate from tank sensor inputs.
The range predictor shall consume the fuel quantity value to compute remaining endurance.
The lidar unit shall provide the obstacle distance measurement at 30 Hz.
The collision avoidance logic shall use the obstacle range measurement to trigger evasive action.
The attitude quaternion and the angular rate vector shall be produced by the inertial reference system.
The stabilizer shall use the attitude quaternion to null residual body rates.
The rate damper shall process the angular rate vector during high-dynamics maneuvers.
The mission timeline and the contact schedule shall be generated by the planning engine before upload.
The scheduler shall retrieve the mission timeline to sequence onboard activities.
The antenna manager shall load the contact schedule for pass preparation.
